game.name: Monster Hunter: World (Console)
game.rules:
**Important:** Runs done with the Iceborne Expansion installed submit to the Iceborne Leaderboards

Complete the game from a new file to the designated category quest. Please see Category Rules for timing and permitted equipment for each category: IL and RTA. History Books, Colossal Task, and Land of Convergence. With Add-ons and No Add-ons.

**Multiplayer (2 - 4 players):** All hunters must be present in the Assigned Quest when it is completed to be a valid quest. All players must have their PoV (Point of View) in the description of the original uploader. This is effective of the 28th September 2019.

The use of mods is currently banned.

categories.name: Land of Convergence
categories.rules:
Complete the quest "Land of Convergence" from a new file.

Timing starts at confirming your character. Timing ends when the camera changes on the last hit in the Quest "Land of Convergence."

The use of Add-ons is permitted for the Add-on Category. Add-ons include the Origin Armour set, the Fair Wind Charm (Pre-order Bonus), the Defender (Guardian) Armour set and Weapons, and the Early Weapon Upgrade Pack. The use of any of this equipment in a submission requires the Add-on category tag.

categories.name: Colossal Task
categories.rules:
Complete the quest "A Colossal Task" from a new file.

Timing starts at confirming your character. Timing ends when the cutscene that ends the mission starts (the first black frame).

The use of Add-ons is permitted for the Add-on Category. Add-ons include the Origin Armour set, the Fair Wind Charm (Pre-order Bonus), the Defender (Guardian) Armour set and Weapons, and the Early Weapon Upgrade Pack. The use of any of this equipment in a submission requires the Add-on category tag. 

Submitting to this category, Land of Convergence with the same submission is allowed.

categories.name: History Books
categories.rules:

categories.name: 1 Player
categories.rules:
**Important:** Runs done with the Iceborne Expansion installed submit to the [Iceborne Leaderboards](https://speedrun.com/mhwib)

Submit using the ingame time shown at the end-screen.
If the end-screen is not shown (Timer on map instead) set 999ms.
Please display gear during the quest, this makes sure that Iceborne gear doesn't clear WR's from World runs!

**Multiplayer Submissions:** Please display all views in the run. You can post a link to the other runner in the description. (Effective of 7th November 2019)

**Rulesets**
For the TA v Ruleset, get your run verified on the TA wiki: http://mhw.wiki-db.com/
and put the link to the run on their site in the description of your submission.
If your run is following TA rules but is not eligible for the TAwiki, submit using TA u.

**TA (v/u) Rules**: http://mhw.wiki-db.com/howtosolota
(English Link: http://mhw.wiki-db.com/howtosolota_en)

Other Rulesets can be requested on the forums or on our discord.

The use of mods is banned.
